title: Insaf maangti hoo
body:
roze jaza adalat e parwardigar mein
haazir hai jo bhi muztarib hai ashke baar mein
faryad kar ke ro rahi hai maa hussain ki
khaalik bhi aaj fatema ka gham gosaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar mein maa ye kehti hai nauha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
wo karbala ki dhoop wo tapti zameen par
ummat ne kar diya mera beta lahoo mein tar
shahid hai mere haath mein kurta hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad ke dukhon se sataya gaya usay
laashe pe us jawan ke rulaya gaya usay
humshakle mustafa tha jo beta hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmon se choor ruqsate qayyaam alwida
matam tha isterab tha kohraam alwida
zainab ko dekh chod kar jaana hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom sirf ek tha zaalim hazaar thay
aur be-khata ki chaak mein teeron ke waar thay
dushman tha jaise saara zamana hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehndi ka rang khoon mein doobi ye baaliyan
asghar ki pyaas dasht mein akbar ki wo azan
laayi ho zuljanah se girna hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar ko jala ke shaam e ghariban guzar gayi
zainab rasan ka baar liye shaam ko chali
sehra mein chodna pada laasha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar tha khataar mein behne aseer thi
thaame chadi wo takht pe baitha tha ek layeen
aur tasht mein kata hua sar tha hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri fughan hai jaun abhi daste yaas mein
irfan inteqam hai chupke libaas mein
ashkon mein leke aayi hoo sajda hussain ka
insaaf maangti hoo mai zehra hussain ka
mehshar mein maa...
author: Jaun
